meta: Cybersecurity services: penetration testing, GRC and compliance, SOC monitoring, vCISO, digital forensics and secure engineering.
h1: Cybersecurity services, from assessment to ongoing protection
lead: Testing, governance, monitoring and security leadership from a team of certified engineers. Start with one service, or bring us in as your security department.

items.p: Hands-on testing of web apps, APIs, mobile apps, networks and cloud, ending in a report and a retest.
SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and PCI DSS readiness, from gap assessment to audit support.
Level 1 monitoring and triage on LogRhythm, QRadar, Sentinel, Elastic or Wazuh.
Security leadership, program management or a complete outsourced security department.
Secure SDLC implementation, security architecture review, threat modeling and CI/CD hardening.
Independent review of your controls, policies and exposure, with a ranked action plan.

blocks.lead: For when something has already gone wrong, and for preparing before it does.

items.p: Careful collection and analysis of evidence from devices, servers and cloud accounts.
Investigation of laptops, servers and mobile devices.
Reconstructing what happened from logs, files and system artifacts.
Understanding what malicious code does and how it got in.
Written plans, rehearsals and hands-on help during an incident.
Clear reports for management, insurers and legal teams, with expert testimony where required.

link: See the certifications held by our team

blocks.lead: Something missing? Ask on the consultation call and we will answer it straight.
items: A penetration test or a gap assessment against the framework you need are the usual first steps. Both give you a clear list of what to fix and in what order.
Do you offer one-off work and ongoing support?
Both. Many clients start with a single assessment and move to monitoring, vCISO support or annual testing.

items.p: Web, mobile and API software with security built in.
AI features, AI security testing and AI governance.
EHR, interoperability, AI and digital health software.
